prompt:
USE: Square album-cover artwork test. Artwork only, no lettering.
SCENE: A dark stone ledge after rain, at night.
SUBJECT: One pale rose lying on the wet stone, lower third of the frame.
DETAILS: Light: Light: fog and soft diffuse light, no hard shadows, haze and depth. Medium: Medium: black and white film snapshot shot with direct flash, grain and small dust specks.
COMPOSITION: Keep the top 30% quiet: no strong edges or highlights, reserved for type added later.
BRAND: An image in the visual world of Inch of Shadow, a Berlin artist. The name comes from the line "one inch of love is one inch of shadow": love and shadow, light and dark. Mood: romantic, melancholic, mysterious, refined.

Everything in the image completes as one whole. Every element belongs; nothing is random or added on.

The light always has one clear idea: a direction, a glow, haze, a flash or a shadow. Never flat, even, commercial light.

Do not add people unless the subject asks for them. When a person is in the image, their attitude is distant and self-possessed, supremely confident, out of reach, sexy in a tasteful way, never explicit. If a real person is in the image, keep their face exactly as it is.

No logos, no watermarks, no text or letters anywhere in the image.
CONSTRAINTS: No text or letters anywhere. No logos, no watermark. No people.
subject: One pale rose lying on the wet stone (test render)
note: The first test render, before the never list existed: it invented a river and a domed church.

review.summary: The rose on wet stone, the quiet top and the film grain all work, but the background shows a domed church-like building and a row of city lights. Today's never list forbids both.

issues.note: A large domed building with towers, which reads as a church or cathedral, sits in the right background. Today's rules forbid domes and religious architecture.
A row of street lights and their reflections runs along the far river bank. The prompt never asked for buildings or city lights.
The waterfront city scene pulls attention from the single rose and adds elements the scene did not ask for, against the brand core of few elements around one focal point.

review.prompt_fix: Replace the SCENE line with: "SCENE: A dark stone ledge after rain, at night, with only deep black fog behind it. No buildings, no domes, no towers, no street lights, no far shore."
